metadata.scenario_context: Emily has finally been accepted into college, and her family is planning a celebration for her academic achievement.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Mongolia strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying lilies as a gift for Emily.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Emily's academic achievement party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you thought about getting flowers for Emily? I was thinking maybe lilies... they’re really nice. 

Do you think that's a good idea?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: Hmm... flowers are nice, but I was thinking something more personal. Maybe a book or something to support her studies? I want to make sure it’s meaningful. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Well, a book sounds good too, but lilies are special, you know? They could represent new beginnings for her in college. 

But... I have to ask, do you think making our parents proud is one of the most important goals in life?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I understand the symbolism of lilies, but I feel like a thoughtful gift can show support too. As for making parents proud—yes, it's a huge goal for me. In my culture, it means everything. I want them to feel honored by my actions and achievements. It's part of who I am.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I get that, but... I just don't see it the same way. Making parents proud shouldn't be the main goal. 

It's more about what we want for ourselves, right? Anyway, back to lilies... they could be a nice addition to whatever we decide. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I see your point, but for me, making my parents proud is a core part of my identity. I can't separate my goals from what they expect of me. About the lilies—maybe we can do both? A gift and flowers together could show her how much we care. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Combining both could work, I suppose. But it's just... I think we should focus more on what Emily wants. 

And honestly, I still believe that making parents proud shouldn’t be the main focus. What about her dreams? Isn’t that more important?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: I understand where you’re coming from about Emily’s dreams. But deep down, we are all the same. We all want to make those we love proud, and I believe that can go hand in hand with pursuing personal dreams. It’s important to support her while also honoring our families. Some values are just universal, and I think we can find a way to blend both of our ideas for Emily's celebration.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message:
I get that some values are universal, but I still think keeping our own goals separate from our families' expectations is key. 

About the celebration, I still think the lilies could really shine. Maybe we can add a personal note to go with the flowers? It could mix that support with something meaningful. What do you think?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: A personal note sounds like a good idea. It adds that thoughtful touch. I just think while we celebrate her, we shouldn't lose sight of our values, like honoring our families. Maybe the note can reflect both her achievements and how proud we are of her, connecting our ideas. It's important to balance both sides, you know?
turns.label: Acceptance
